00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:11.720: A sustained, resonant bell tone, low-pitched and metallic, rings out with slow decay, filling the acoustic space.

00:00:11.720 --> 00:00:13.000: Silence — no speech, no ambient sound, no background noise.

00:00:13.000 --> 00:00:28.000: A male voice begins speaking in a calm, measured tone: “Nirvana is when everything the mind makes comes to a stop...”

00:00:28.000 --> 00:00:30.000: The male voice pauses briefly — no speech, no ambient sound.

00:00:30.000 --> 00:00:45.000: The same male voice continues: “This is peaceful. This is excellent. Namely, the stilling of all preparations...”

00:00:45.000 --> 00:00:47.000: Silence — no speech, no ambient sound.

00:00:47.000 --> 00:00:53.000: A different male voice, slightly higher in pitch and with a more questioning tone, asks: “Why don’t I see Nirvana right now?”

00:00:53.000 --> 00:00:55.000: Silence — no speech, no ambient sound.

00:00:55.000 --> 00:01:10.000: The first male voice resumes: “You do not see Nirvana right now, because you imagine a seer and a world, and neither is there.”

00:01:10.000 --> 00:01:12.000: Silence — no speech, no ambient sound.

00:01:12.000 --> 00:01:25.000: The first male voice continues: “What is called ‘manana’ is the imagining in egoistic terms, imparting reality to illusory things...”

00:01:25.000 --> 00:01:27.000: Silence — no speech, no ambient sound.

00:01:27.000 --> 00:01:38.000: The first male voice continues: “Only a looking is there, nothing worth looking at. Only a seeing is there, nothing to be seen.”

00:01:38.000 --> 00:01:40.000: Silence — no speech, no ambient sound.

00:01:40.000 --> 00:01:48.000: The first male voice continues: “The law of dependent arising is already implicated. There is therefore no seer apart from the phenomenon of seeing, according to the Tathagata.”

00:01:48.000 --> 00:01:50.000: Silence — no speech, no ambient sound.

00:01:50.000 --> 00:01:55.000: The second male voice asks: “What keeps it going?”

00:01:55.000
